meta.name: Viraatapalem PC Meena Reporting
meta.description: Set in the 1980s in the remote and fear-stricken, eerie village of Viraatapalem, which faces a strange chilling curse – every bride dies mysteriously on her wedding day, halting marriages for over a decade. A determined police constable refuses to believe this superstition and, along with a reformed convict, begins to unearth shocking secrets the villagers want hidden.

videos.title: The Red Wedding
videos.overview: The people of Viraatapalem believe that the recent death of a newly married girl, Durga, was caused by a curse. On the other hand, Meena, a young police officer, arrives in the village.

videos.title: The Bride and the Curse
videos.overview: Villager Ranga marries Malli, despite the warnings about the curse. Tragedy soon strikes as Malli collapses near the temple and dies on the spot. The villagers blame the dreaded curse.

videos.title: Staking It All
videos.overview: Meena tries to register a case about Malli’s mysterious death but is put on hold. Meanwhile, the village president asks Meena to marry his son and is stunned by her reply.

videos.title: Encounter With The Truth
videos.overview: The wedding festivities for Meena and the president’s son begin, while the villagers fear the curse will strike. Meena collapses but counters by filing a case, declaring herself a victim.

videos.title: Forever Bride
videos.overview: Meena launches an investigation, determined to unravel the mystery behind the deaths. As she digs deeper, her wedding gets abruptly called off. Her investigation takes her to a point of no return.

videos.title: The Last Straw
videos.overview: Meena’s investigation gets pushed back due to a transfer order. On her visit to the headquarters, she discovers that Narsayya recommended her transfer. Sensing foul play, Meena digs into his past.

videos.title: Mystery of Viraatapalem
videos.overview: Meena helps two villagers get married with support from the village president, despite everyone's fear of the curse. Can Meena expose the real culprit behind the deaths before another life is lost?
